Final pricing/quote contract: POST /api/v1/pricing/quote, body { pickupLat:number, pickupLng:number, dropoffLat?:number, dropoffLng?:number, at?:string(ISO) }; response discriminated union on type: {type:'Fixed', priceCzk, routeId, routeName} | {type:'Estimate', lowCzk, highCzk, distanceKm, durationMin} | {type:'Meter', baseCzk, perKmCzk, minimumCzk}. NOTE for B1: the FastEndpoints serializer sets NO DefaultIgnoreCondition, so NULL union fields ARE emitted (a Fixed response includes lowCzk:null,highCzk:null,... etc) — B1's discriminated-union typing must discriminate on 'type', not on field presence. Added Quote_AtNightWindow_ReturnsSeededNightRoute (at-binding + seeded night route E2E) and restored precise Quote_EstimateBand_IsTariffPricePlusMinus10RoundedTo10.
